info.title: OpenVibe.Deals API
info.description: Routes of OpenVibe.Deals as the OpenVibe contracts describe them (openvibe-contracts 0.407.0): each operation lists the capabilities it performs; a token for the service's audience must carry one of them unless the route is open. Generated by openvibe-contracts lib/openapi.js; do not edit.

get.summary: Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags.
get.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.summary: Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags.
post.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.summary: Submit a deal for the acting person (X-OV-Subject): a link, title and what the person sees now (price with its currency, shipping, condition, availability — each optional, never defaulted).
post.description: **deals.offer.submit** (public): Submit a deal for the acting person (X-OV-Subject): a link, title and what the person sees now (price with its currency, shipping, condition, availability — each optional, never defaulted). The first observation is recorded with its time. A link already posted answers 409 offer.duplicate with the existing offer. With X-OV-Origin: ai the text is AI-assisted: disclosed and noindex until a person reviews it. Rate-limited per person.

patch.summary: Edit an offer the acting person submitted (title, description, category, stated expiry, product link), or record a new observation of any active offer for the acting person (POST …/observations: price
patch.description: **deals.offer.update** (public): Edit an offer the acting person submitted (title, description, category, stated expiry, product link), or record a new observation of any active offer for the acting person (POST …/observations: price with currency, shipping, condition, availability, with the time it was observed). Prices are never edited in place; each observation is a new row. Services may state observed_at (never in the future).

post.summary: Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags.
post.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.summary: Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags.
post.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.summary: Mark an active offer expired (the person who submitted it, or a moderator).
post.description: **deals.offer.expire** (first-party): Mark an active offer expired (the person who submitted it, or a moderator). Unknown expiry is never assumed; offers with a stated end expire on their own.

post.summary: Report a problem with an offer for the acting person (expired, price_wrong, duplicate, spam, other).
post.description: **deals.flag.create** (public): Report a problem with an offer for the acting person (expired, price_wrong, duplicate, spam, other). One open report per person and offer; rate-limited. Flags never change an offer by themselves.

post.summary: Duplicate resolution (moderation): merge an offer into another, or unmerge it.
post.description: **deals.offer.merge** (first-party): Duplicate resolution (moderation): merge an offer into another, or unmerge it. Nothing is copied or deleted: votes, observations, sources and comments stay where they were written and the canonical offer reads across the group (a voter counts once). Audited with the tallies before and after; reversible.

post.summary: Edit an offer the acting person submitted (title, description, category, stated expiry, product link), or record a new observation of any active offer for the acting person (POST …/observations: price
post.description: **deals.offer.update** (public): Edit an offer the acting person submitted (title, description, category, stated expiry, product link), or record a new observation of any active offer for the acting person (POST …/observations: price with currency, shipping, condition, availability, with the time it was observed). Prices are never edited in place; each observation is a new row. Services may state observed_at (never in the future).

post.summary: Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags.
post.description: **deals.offer.moderate** (first-party): Moderation: disable or enable an offer, record a person's review of imported or AI-assisted text (reviews are recorded for a usr_ subject only), read and resolve flags including vote-ring flags. Audited.

post.description: **deals.offer.merge** (first-party): Duplicate resolution (moderation): merge an offer into another, or unmerge it. Nothing is copied or deleted: votes, observations, sources and comments stay where they were written and the canonical offer reads across the group (a voter counts once). Audited with the tallies before and after; reversible.

delete.summary: Remove the acting person's vote on an offer (kept as a removed row for history).
delete.description: **deals.vote.remove** (public): Remove the acting person's vote on an offer (kept as a removed row for history). Same abuse controls as deals.vote.set.

put.summary: Set the acting person's vote (+1 / -1) on an offer.
put.description: **deals.vote.set** (public): Set the acting person's vote (+1 / -1) on an offer. Server-authoritative: weight and hotness are computed by Deals (hot@1), never taken from the request. Rate-limited per person, per IP hash and per offer; no votes on one's own offer; vote-ring detection flags moderators.

post.summary: Resolve a product by its aliases (gtin, mpn, sku, exact name, url), creating it when none matches (create: false to only look up).
post.description: **deals.product.resolve** (first-party): Resolve a product by its aliases (gtin, mpn, sku, exact name, url), creating it when none matches (create: false to only look up). Aliases that already name another product are reported as conflicts, never re-pointed.

get.summary: List the acting person's watches and saved searches with their notification counts.
get.description: **deals.watch.read** (public): List the acting person's watches and saved searches with their notification counts.

post.summary: Create a keyword, product or price-below watch, or a saved search (never notifies), for the acting person.
post.description: **deals.watch.create** (public): Create a keyword, product or price-below watch, or a saved search (never notifies), for the acting person. A watch notifies at most once per observation (deals.watch.matched, internal; Deals never emails).

delete.summary: Delete one of the acting person's watches or saved searches.
delete.description: **deals.watch.delete** (public): Delete one of the acting person's watches or saved searches.

get.summary: Manage the configuration namespaces and secrets of OpenVibe.Deals through openvibe-shared/config (D11), so the owner can give its keys and accounts on Network's Setup tab: GET /internal/config lists t
get.description: **deals.config.manage** (internal): Manage the configuration namespaces and secrets of OpenVibe.Deals through openvibe-shared/config (D11), so the owner can give its keys and accounts on Network's Setup tab: GET /internal/config lists the namespace summaries, GET /internal/config/:namespace returns one as common.config-namespace@1, POST applies common.config-change@1, and PUT /internal/config/:namespace/secrets/:key sets a secret with common.config-secret-put@1 (write-only; the answer is the marker) while DELETE removes it. POST /internal/config/:namespace/test/:key asks the service's tester to try a stored value with the provider on the server, answering { ok, message } in one line that never carries a secret (the owner's Setup tab). Only Network's admin proxy, acting for the owner, holds this capability; it is never grantable to apps. Each request carries the owner as actor, and the service audits every write with that actor and key, never a secret value.

common.config-change.v1.title: ConfigChange
common.config-change.v1.description: common.config-change@1 (AI Exchange D11): body of POST /internal/config/:namespace on a service's openvibe-shared/config admin routes. It proposes a new revision of the namespace and activates it (the store validates against the namespace schema, applies env pins and calls onActivate). `merge: true` starts from the active values; otherwise `values` is the whole new set. `unset` removes keys. A secret-class key's value is never sent here: it is 422 config.secret_write_only; use common.config-secret-put@1.

values.description: The new values, one member per key. The store validates them against the namespace schema; a secret-class value here is refused.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value; a redaction marker keeps the value it stands for.

reason.description: Why the change is made; it is the revision's reason in the history.

merge.description: Merge into the active values instead of replacing them.

unset.description: Keys to remove from the new revision.

common.config-namespace.v1.title: ConfigNamespace
common.config-namespace.v1.description: common.config-namespace@1 (AI Exchange D11): one service configuration namespace as openvibe-shared/config's summary() returns it (config-pg.js), plus `sealed`, `pins` and `schema`. GET /internal/config lists these for a service and GET /internal/config/:namespace returns one. Values are the active ones over the defaults, with every secret-class value replaced by its marker; a marker never carries the value. `sealed` says whether the service has a KEK so secrets are envelopes (false is the pre-D11 plaintext behaviour). `pins` names the keys whose x-env variable is set, so their effective value is the environment's and a write is 409 config.pinned_in_env. `schema` is the namespace's JSON Schema so a client can draw the form; its annotations are title, description, x-group, x-env, x-danger, x-bind and x-unit (nano_usd, ms, bps, seconds), and for the owner's Setup tab and the clear admin panel (openvibe-shared 4.125.0) x-owner-input ({ group, unlocks, get_it_at, get_it_how, test }: a field only the owner can give), x-required-for (the feature an unset field blocks), x-enum-labels ({ value: { label, description } }), x-advanced (folded under Advanced settings) and x-example (a placeholder; never on a secret).

revision.description: The active revision; null before the namespace has one.

values.description: The active values over the defaults, one member per key. A secret-class key's value is a marker, never the value.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value. An object with a redacted member is a secret marker, and nothing else.

classification.description: Every key of values, classified. A key the service does not classify is internal.

sealed.description: True when the service has a KEK: secret-class values are stored as envelopes and only opened for a caller that needs them. False keeps the pre-D11 plaintext-inside-values_json behaviour, and the tab shows it in red.

pins.description: The keys whose x-env variable is set in the service process: their effective value is the environment's, read-only, and a write answers 409 config.pinned_in_env.

schema.description: The namespace's JSON Schema, or null when it has none. Annotations the client may read: title, description, x-group, x-env, x-danger, x-bind (the key whose value the secret is bound to), x-unit (nano_usd, ms, bps or seconds), x-owner-input, x-required-for, x-enum-labels, x-advanced and x-example.

active.description: The active revision as a snapshot (common.config-snapshot@1), or null.

last_known_good.description: The last revision that activated cleanly (common.config-snapshot@1), or null.

marker.description: A secret-class value, as the summary and the secret endpoints show it: never the value. The fingerprint is keyed, so equal fingerprints within one namespace mean the value did not change.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of the value, keyed with the namespace's secret key.

hint.description: The four-character hint (the value's last four characters), never more.

bound_to.description: The value of the key named by x-bind when the secret was set, e.g. a provider base_url origin.

common.config-snapshot.v1.title: ConfigSnapshot
common.config-snapshot.v1.description: One immutable revision of one service's configuration namespace (roadmap WS-C task 7; kept by openvibe-shared/config). A revision's values never change: revisions grow by one per namespace, and a rollback is a new revision that copies an older one's values. Only the state moves: proposed -> active -> superseded or rolled_back, or proposed -> rejected when validation or activation fails, in which case the previous active revision stays or is restored. A secret-class key's value never appears here: it is { redacted: true, fingerprint }, an HMAC-SHA256 of the value under a secret key the service keeps per namespace, so equal fingerprints within one namespace mean the value did not change, while the value cannot be recovered or guessed offline without that key. checksum is the sha256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace) of values exactly as they appear here, secrets as their markers, so anyone can check it, and two snapshots of one namespace with the same checksum hold the same configuration.

previous_revision.description: The revision that was active when this one was proposed; null for the namespace's first.

values.description: The configuration, one member per key. A secret-class key's value is a redaction marker.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value. An object with a redacted member is a redaction marker, and nothing else.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of the value, keyed with the namespace's secret key: equal within one namespace when the value is unchanged, and not recoverable or guessable without the key.

classification.description: Every key of values, classified. A key the service does not classify is internal.

checksum.description: sha256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of values as they appear in this snapshot (secrets as their markers).

activated_at.description: When it became active; null while proposed, and for a rejected revision.

error.description: Why it was rejected: the validation errors, or what activation reported. Never a secret value.

copied_from.description: A rollback's source: the revision whose values this one copies.

common.no-body.v1.title: NoBody
common.no-body.v1.description: common.no-body@1: the capability's request carries no body; its parameters are the path and query of the routes in implementedBy (an id, a page cursor). An input schema that says so explicitly, so every active capability names one (roadmap WS-C task 4).

deals.flag-request.v1.title: DealsFlagRequest
deals.flag-request.v1.description: deals.flag-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/offers/:id/flags on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.flag.create; a person): { kind, reason?, duplicate_of? } — duplicate_of (the other deal, id, slug or /d/ link) is required for kind duplicate. An open flag of the same kind by the same person is refreshed, not repeated.

deals.flag-result.v1.title: DealsFlagResult
deals.flag-result.v1.description: deals.flag-result@1: the answer of POST /api/v1/offers/:id/flags on OpenVibe.Deals: { flag: { id, kind, status }, created } (201 when created, 200 when an open flag was refreshed).

deals.moderation-request.v1.title: DealsModerationRequest
deals.moderation-request.v1.description: deals.moderation-request@1: bodies of deals.offer.moderate on OpenVibe.Deals (moderators). POST /api/v1/offers/:id/disable: { reason } (3-300 characters); POST …/enable: { reason? }; POST …/review (a person): { note? }; POST /api/v1/flags/:id/resolve: { status?: resolved (default) | dismissed, resolution? }. GET /api/v1/flags?status= takes no body.

deals.moderation-result.v1.title: DealsModerationResult
deals.moderation-result.v1.description: deals.moderation-result@1: answers of deals.offer.moderate on OpenVibe.Deals. POST /api/v1/offers/:id/disable|enable|review → { offer }; GET /api/v1/flags?status=open|resolved|dismissed → { flags }; POST /api/v1/flags/:id/resolve → { flag, changed } (changed false when it was no longer open).

deals.offer-action-request.v1.title: DealsOfferActionRequest
deals.offer-action-request.v1.description: deals.offer-action-request@1: bodies of the deal actions on OpenVibe.Deals. POST /api/v1/offers/:id/expire (deals.offer.expire; the submitter or a moderator): { reason? } (a moderator's reason is recorded). POST …/disable (deals.offer.moderate): { reason } (3-300 characters, required); POST …/enable: { reason? }; POST …/review (a person): { note? }. POST …/merge (deals.offer.merge, moderators): { into, reason? } (the canonical deal, id or slug; no cycles, not an already merged offer); POST …/unmerge: { reason? }.

deals.offer-result.v1.title: DealsOfferResult
deals.offer-result.v1.description: deals.offer-result@1: the answer of the deal writes on OpenVibe.Deals: { offer } (the canonical offer after the change). POST /api/v1/offers (201), PATCH /api/v1/offers/:id, POST …/expire, …/disable, …/enable and …/review answer exactly that; POST …/observations (201) adds the observation recorded; POST …/merge adds merged { id, slug } and the before/after of the change; POST …/unmerge adds from { id, slug } and before/after.

deals.offer-submit-request.v1.title: DealsOfferSubmitRequest
deals.offer-submit-request.v1.description: deals.offer-submit-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/offers on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.offer.submit; a signed-in person, or a service acting for one; X-OV-Origin: ai holds the text for review). url (an http(s) link to the offer; a link already posted is 409 offer.duplicate) and title (3-200 characters) are required; a price or shipping cost needs its currency; expires_at may not be in the past. The first price observation is recorded with it.

product.description: Product aliases to resolve (or create) the product.

price.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

shipping.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

deals.offer-update-request.v1.title: DealsOfferUpdateRequest
deals.offer-update-request.v1.description: deals.offer-update-request@1: bodies of deals.offer.update on OpenVibe.Deals. PATCH /api/v1/offers/:id (the submitter or a moderator): { title?, description?, category?, expires_at?, product_slug? | product?, ai_summary? } (ai_summary only from OpenVibe.AI with X-OV-Origin: ai; product null detaches it). POST /api/v1/offers/:id/observations (a person): a price report — at least a price, shipping cost, availability or condition, with the currency of any amount; services may give observed_at (not in the future).

anyOf.description: Product aliases to resolve (or create) the product.

price.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

shipping.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

deals.offer.v1.title: DealsOffer
deals.offer.v1.description: deals.offer@1: one deal as OpenVibe.Deals presents it (server/domain/publication.js offerDto; the API and /d/:slug.json): the canonical (root) offer of a merge group with its store, product, price observations (the latest is "latest", never "current": freshness says whether it still holds), sources, the offers merged into it, votes, hotness and the indexability decision.

deals.product-resolve-request.v1.title: DealsProductResolveRequest
deals.product-resolve-request.v1.description: deals.product-resolve-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/products/resolve on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.product.resolve): product aliases (gtin 8-14 digits, mpn, sku, url, name) to find the product by; with create (default true) a product is made when none matches (name then required, 2-200 characters).

deals.product-resolve-result.v1.title: DealsProductResolveResult
deals.product-resolve-result.v1.description: deals.product-resolve-result@1: the answer of POST /api/v1/products/resolve on OpenVibe.Deals: { product, created, conflicts } — 201 when the product was created; conflicts lists aliases that pointed elsewhere. Nothing matching with create false is 404 product.not_found.

deals.vote-request.v1.title: DealsVoteRequest
deals.vote-request.v1.description: deals.vote-request@1: the body of PUT /api/v1/offers/:id/vote on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.vote.set; a person): { value: 1 | -1 }. DELETE /api/v1/offers/:id/vote (deals.vote.remove) takes no body.

deals.vote-result.v1.title: DealsVoteResult
deals.vote-result.v1.description: deals.vote-result@1: the answer of PUT and DELETE /api/v1/offers/:id/vote on OpenVibe.Deals: { offer_id, value (0 after a removal), previous, changed, votes } — the vote lands on the canonical offer of a merge group.

deals.watch-request.v1.title: DealsWatchRequest
deals.watch-request.v1.description: deals.watch-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/watches on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.watch.create; the acting person): kind keyword or search (query with at least one word; a search is saved without notifications), product (product, a slug or id), or price_below (max_price and currency, with a product or keywords). label is optional (120 characters). There is a per-person limit (429 watch.limit).

max_price.description: A decimal amount; always with its currency.

deals.watch-result.v1.title: DealsWatchResult
deals.watch-result.v1.description: deals.watch-result@1: answers of the watch routes on OpenVibe.Deals: GET /api/v1/watches → { watches } (the acting person's; deals.watch.read); POST /api/v1/watches → 201 { watch } (deals.watch.create); DELETE /api/v1/watches/:id → { id, deleted: true } (deals.watch.delete; someone else's watch is 404).

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

identity.subject-ref.v1.title: SubjectRef
identity.subject-ref.v1.description: The one cross-platform reference to an actor. Issued by OpenVibe.Network. Never a service-local integer id.

oneOf.description: AgentSubject: an agent (OpenVibe.Actor, or a developer app's agent) acting under grants its owner delegated (roadmap WS-Z2). In an event envelope, on_behalf_of names the owner.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
